news.title: Butler University Welcomes Blue V, the Next Generation of Its Beloved Live Mascot Program
news.summary_en: There’s a new top dawg at Butler University. Butler officially introduced Blue V, a red fawn English bulldog puppy, as the fifth mascot in its celebrated Live Mascot Program on Friday, November 13.
